posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal have welcomed a baby boy, sharing heartfelt pregnancy updates and romantic Rajasthan vacation photos with fans on Instagram.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit made history as the first South Asian artist to sell out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden on his AURA tour. His Partition-era film 'Main Vaapas Aaunga' with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman is generating massive buzz.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia is gearing up for spy thriller 'Alpha' alongside Sharvari, with Cannes Film Festival appearances and her highly anticipated combat scene with Bobby Deol keeping her in the spotlight.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka gifted matching sneakers to Nick Jonas and daughter Malti for Father's Day while speculation about a Bollywood comeback with Sanjay Leela Bhansali continues to swirl.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's action thriller 'King' with daughter Suhana Khan and Deepika Padukone is confirmed for Christmas 2026 with a ₹350 crore budget. He missed most of IPL 2026 filming in South Africa as KKR exited the playoffs.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is set to reunite with Salman Khan in a superhero film directed by Raj & DK, their first collaboration in over a decade. Filming begins October 2026 with a 2027 release.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha signed a massive ₹17 crore deal for a female-led thriller with Ekta Kapoor. She's also confirmed for Stree 3 and a period musical drama directed by Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh and is using a body double for action in SRK's 'King' and Atlee's 'Raka.' She also reunites with Prabhas in Sandeep Reddy Vanga's 'Spirit.'

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: FWICE issued a non-cooperation directive against Ranveer on May 25 over his Don 3 exit, seeking ₹45 crore in damages. He was spotted at Mumbai Airport on May 26 avoiding paparazzi, and visited Chamundeshwari Temple after a court directive.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya closed Cannes 2026 with a stunning feathered cape and ivory couture in her 24th appearance. Daughter Aaradhya beamed with pride as fans chanted her name during autograph signing.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika presented at the Crunchyroll Anime Awards 2026 in Tokyo, with Black Panther's Winston Duke calling her 'incomparable.' Her romantic track 'Tujhko' from Cocktail 2 with Shahid Kapoor drops ahead of the June 19 release.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's comeback trailer for 'Maa Inti Bangaaram' dropped May 25, showcasing a fierce daughter-in-law avatar with intense action sequences. The Nandini Reddy-directed film releases June 19.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's sci-fi film with director Atlee has been officially announced with behind-the-scenes footage and a massive ₹600 crore budget. He also went viral for hilariously calling Jasprit Bumrah a 'football player' at an event.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama 'Peddi' is set for a June 4 release with record-breaking North American pre-sales crossing $393K. He apologized for his viral gaffe of calling Jasprit Bumrah a 'footballer' at the Peddi launch.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's period actioner 'Dragon' with Prashanth Neel is now locked for June 2027, with Anil Kapoor joining as the villain. His four-film lineup also includes War 2, Devara 2, and a Nelson Dilipkumar project.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi co-stars with Ram Charan in 'Peddi' releasing June 4, with the CBFC flagging explicit content in the film. She also turned heads at the New Balance Grey Days 2026 event alongside cricketer Pat Cummins.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's 'Chand Mera Dil' with Lakshya crossed ₹18 crore worldwide in its opening days, getting a BOGO push to draw youth audiences. Her fusion Bharatanatyam dance went viral amid heated online debate.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara shut down 'absolute nonsense' rumors about requesting cuts in 'Toxic,' releasing June 4. She's also confirmed to portray legendary actress Madhubala in a Sanjay Leela Bhansali biopic.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is set to make his directorial debut with Krrish 4, co-produced with Yash Raj Films and aiming for a 2027 release. War 2 with Jr NTR secured ₹225 crore in non-theatrical deals despite a mixed box office run.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com 'Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai' with father David Dhawan has been pushed to June 12 to avoid clashing with Yash's 'Toxic.' Salman Khan hilariously roasted him for recreating 'Chunari Chunari.'

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya's 'Unstoppable Tour' hits the US this fall with dates in Newark (September 5) and Boston. Her 'Letters to Lata Didi' tribute concert in Mumbai honored the late legend through heartfelt video messages and iconic songs.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman is collaborating with Hans Zimmer on the epic ₹4,000 crore Ramayana soundtrack starring Ranbir Kapoor, calling it his most significant project ever. He also performed live in Bhopal for the Peddi promotion.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay celebrated his birthday with wishes pouring in from stars across industries. His final film 'Jana Nayagan' targets a June/July release after legal delays as he transitions to full-time politics.
